scenario.headline: Cautious scenario: keep exposure small or avoid it until the picture improves
scenario.summary: The evidence leans negative. The plan is to keep exposure small or avoid it, and to name the level at which that view would be dropped.

levels.label: Where the cautious view would be wrong
levels.meaning: a close above the 50-day average would argue against staying cautious

levels.label: Weakness confirmed below
levels.meaning: a close below the 52-week low would add to the cautious reading

stages.label: Largest exposure in this scenario
stages.condition: a third of the ceiling at most

watch: Next quarterly results are due by 14 Feb 2027 (a deadline estimate; the company may report earlier)
Promoter pledge and holding change with each quarterly shareholding filing
The rating is recomputed from fresh data each run; a changed rating changes this plan
more_positive_if: Momentum scores only 22 of 100 against the comparison pool
Growth scores only 29 of 100 against the comparison pool
Profit covers interest costs only 2.6 times; 3 or more is more comfortable
more_cautious_if: Risk scores 83 of 100 against the comparison pool
Profit grew 49% compared with a year earlier
Sales grew 26% compared with a year earlier
notes: the ceiling is 10.0% of a portfolio: risk per position divided by the volatility-based stop distance, capped by your single-stock limit

prose.favour: The case in its favour rests mostly on growth: profit grew 49% compared with a year earlier. Also in its favour: sales grew 26% compared with a year earlier; and risk scores 83 of 100 against the comparison pool. Other areas on this side: risk.
prose.against: The case against rests mostly on the recent price trend: momentum scores only 22 of 100 against the comparison pool. Also against it: the share price is 11.0% lower than a year ago; over the past year the share did 8.7 percentage points worse than the Nifty 50; and the share price is 25% below its 52-week high.
